report.title: 2025 Annual Water Quality Report - CA4310011 San Jose Water Main System / CA4310018 City of Cupertino

sources_described: San Jose Water supplies a mix of local mountain surface water from about 6,000 acres of SJW watershed in the Los Gatos Creek and Saratoga Creek watersheds (Santa Cruz Mountains), groundwater from SJW wells in the Santa Clara Valley, and imported treated surface water purchased from Valley Water; the City of Cupertino municipal system (CA4310018) is operated by SJW under lease and is covered by this joint report.
search_log: WebSearch 'Cupertino Municipal Water System 2025 water quality report San Jose Water Company' -> joint SJW report PDF https://www.sjwater.com/media/ixleehrg/ca4310011_ca4310018-sjw-2025-ccr-002.pdf whose cover lists 'CA4310011 San Jose Water Main System' and 'CA4310018 City of Cupertino'

extraction_notes: The report is a combined 2025 CCR for CA4310011 (San Jose Water Main System) and CA4310018 (City of Cupertino, operated by SJW under lease); its tables are by water-source type, not by PWSID, and the text never says which source column serves Cupertino (the service-area map on p.5 is an image), so all three source columns are included: 'Mountain Surface Water', 'Groundwater', 'VW Surface Water' (Valley Water imported treated water; p.6 footnote: concentrations provided by SJW's wholesaler). Tables: Primary standards p.6 (Surface Water Prior to Treatment, Surface Water Treatment turbidity, Entry Point Samples, SJW Distribution Samples), Secondary / Notification Levels / UCMR 5 p.7, Lead and Copper p.8; the 'Source Water PFAS Results' table on p.11 repeats the p.7 Notification Levels PFHxS/PFOA/PFOS values exactly and is not entered twice. Cells printed N/A (Cryptosporidium and Giardia under Groundwater; Fluoride (treated) under Mountain Surface Water and Groundwater) and NS = Not Sampled (Boron MSW and GW; Vanadium MSW; PFHxS/PFOA/PFOS under VW Surface Water) have no entry. Where the Average cell is ND but the Range has a numeric high, value = range high (value_basis 'range_high'). Distribution-system rows (Total Chlorine, TTHM, HAA5, Coliform Bacteria), UCMR 5 and Lead/Copper are system-wide, source_group null. pdftotext fuses footnote superscripts on p.6 ('Turbidity1', 'N/A2', '0.753', '0.6-0.93'); Fluoride (treated) is read as 0.75 and 0.6-0.9 with footnote 3. No violations or exceedances are disclosed: the president's letter says results 'meet all state and federal drinking water standards' and every table row is marked 'Yes' under 'Met Drinking Water Standards?'; lead/copper show 1 sample > AL in each 2025 round but 90th percentiles below the AL. Groundwater PFHxS average 3.2 ppt exceeds the 3 ppt NL (footnote: includes offline standby wells; p.10 text: highest average among active wells 5.97 ppt, below the 10 ppt RL).
